seo.title: GİRVAK — Entrepreneurship Foundation of Türkiye
seo.description: The transformation of Türkiye begins with investing in people. Since 2014, GİRVAK brings the entrepreneurial perspective to young people, founders and the ecosystem.

what_we_do.text: A two-year journey selecting 40 young people a year for potential, not pedigree.
Training the next generation in AI, data, gaming and applied technology.
Founder First — one-to-one matching that carries ventures from idea to growth.
Long-horizon partnerships with corporates and institutions to grow capacity.
Creating the foundation for an interconnected ecosystem that naturally gives back and grows together.
Creating a common ground that brings diverse stakeholders together for a shared purpose.

partners.sub: GİRVAK creates a common ground where ideas, people, and opportunities meet to strengthen Türkiye's entrepreneurship ecosystem. Together with our partners, we shape the future.
